description: Document creation and assembly tools for Adobe InDesign. Create new documents, apply templates, assemble multi-page documents, manage pages and spreads, and control document structure.

tools.name: indesign_create_document
tools.short_description: Create new blank InDesign document with custom page size, margins, and bleed settings
tools.description:
Create a new blank InDesign document (.indd file) with specified page settings.

Creates fresh document with:
- Custom page dimensions and orientation
- Specified page count
- Margin and column settings
- Facing pages or single pages
- Bleed and slug areas for print

Use this tool when:
- User wants to start new document from scratch
- User needs custom page size not in templates
- User is creating one-off design not based on template
- User wants full control over document setup

Common scenarios:
1. 'Create a blank 8.5x11 document' → Letter-size document
2. 'Make a new brochure with 6 pages' → Multi-page document
3. 'Create A4 document with bleed' → European size with print bleed
4. 'Start new catalog with 50 pages' → Large document structure

Important notes:
- Returns document_id for subsequent operations
- Document starts blank (use other tools to add content)
- Page numbering starts at 1 by default
- Facing pages create left/right spreads
- Bleed extends beyond page for print trimming

Best practices:
- Set proper bleed (0.125in standard) for printed documents
- Use facing pages for books/magazines
- Add margins appropriate to content type
- Save frequently during document creation

width.description: Page width with units (e.g., '8.5in', '210mm', '612pt'). Common: Letter=8.5in, A4=210mm

height.description: Page height with units. Common: Letter=11in, A4=297mm, Tabloid=17in

page_size.description: Page dimensions. Standard sizes: Letter (8.5x11in), A4 (210x297mm), Legal (8.5x14in), Tabloid (11x17in)

page_count.description: Initial number of pages to create (1-9999). Can add more pages later.

facing_pages.description: True for spreads with left/right pages (books, magazines). False for single pages (flyers, posters).

orientation.description: Page orientation. Portrait = tall, Landscape = wide.

margins.description: Page margins. Use inside/outside for facing pages, or top/bottom/left/right for single pages.

columns.description: Column grid settings for text layout

bleed.description: Bleed area (extends beyond page for print trimming). Standard: 0.125in all sides.

slug.description: Slug area for print notes (outside bleed, trimmed off). Typically 0.5in bottom.

output_path.description: Full path where document will be saved (e.g., 'C:/Projects/catalog.indd'). If omitted, saves to temp folder.

document_id.description: Unique document identifier for subsequent operations

examples.description: Catalog with facing pages and bleed

when_to_use: User wants to create new document from scratch (not from template)
User needs custom page size not available in templates
User is creating one-off design without reusable structure
User wants full control over document setup parameters
when_not_to_use: User has template to use (call indesign_create_document_from_template instead)
User wants pre-defined styles and layouts (use templates)
User is creating standardized document (templates are better)
workflow: Step 1: Determine page size, count, and layout requirements
Step 3: Store returned document_id for subsequent operations
Step 4: Add content with indesign_add_text_frame(), indesign_place_image(), etc.
Step 6: Export with indesign_export_pdf() when complete
best_practices: Set bleed to 0.125in for printed documents (standard trim allowance)
Use facing pages for books, magazines, catalogs (enables spreads)
Add appropriate margins: wider inside margins for binding
Use column grids for text-heavy layouts (easier alignment)
Save document_id immediately - you'll need it for all subsequent operations
Start with fewer pages, add more as needed (easier than deleting)
Use slug area for print notes, crop marks (trimmed off in final print)
error_handling: Error 'Invalid page size' → Must include units (8.5in, not 8.5)
Error 'Page count exceeds limit' → Max 9999 pages per document
Error 'Invalid margin' → Margins can't be larger than page dimensions
Error 'Bleed extends beyond page' → Bleed should be 0.125in-0.25in typically
Error 'Output path not accessible' → Verify folder exists and has write permissions
Error 'Document name conflict' → File already exists at output_path
related_tools: indesign_create_document_from_template - Use template instead of blank doc
indesign_add_pages - Add more pages after document creation
indesign_add_text_frame - Add content to created document

typical_use_cases: Creating product catalogs with multi-page layout
Designing business cards with bleed for print

conversation_memory_hints.what_to_remember: Document name, page count, page size, document_id
conversation_memory_hints.search_context: When user refers back to 'that catalog I started' or 'the document we created'

tools.name: indesign_create_document_from_template
tools.description:
Create a new InDesign document from an existing template (.indt file).

Creates document by:
- Loading template structure (master pages, styles, placeholders)
- Creating new .indd file
- Preserving template formatting
- Optionally pre-filling data merge placeholders
- Maintaining all template styles and assets

Use this tool when:
- User wants to create document from template
- User needs consistent formatting from template
- User is starting data merge workflow
- User wants to reuse existing design structure

Common scenarios:
1. 'Create catalog from template' → Load template, ready for data
2. 'Use business card template for new client' → New doc with template structure
3. 'Generate 50 brochures from template' → Batch document creation
4. 'Start new project with brand template' → Consistent brand application

Advantages over blank document:
- Pre-defined styles save formatting time
- Master pages ensure consistency
- Placeholders ready for data merge
- Brand elements already positioned
- Faster than recreating layout

This is the recommended way to create documents when templates exist.

template_id.description: Template identifier (from indesign_list_templates) or path to .indt file

path.description: Path to data file or database connection string

mapping.description: Map data fields to template placeholders

data_source.description: Optional data source to pre-fill template placeholders

output_path.description: Where to save new document. If omitted, uses default location.

placeholders_filled.description: Count of placeholders populated with data

examples.description: Create from template with data merge

when_to_use: User has template and wants to create document from it
User needs consistent formatting across multiple documents
User is running data merge workflow with placeholders
User wants to save time by using pre-built structure
workflow: Step 1: Call indesign_list_templates() to find available templates
Step 2: Optionally call indesign_get_template_details() to see placeholders
Step 4: If data_source provided, placeholders auto-fill
Step 5: Add additional content with other tools if needed
best_practices: Always check template placeholders before data merge
Use templates for consistent brand application
Map data fields exactly to placeholder names
Test template with sample data first
Keep template and documents in separate folders
error_handling: Error 'Template not found' → Verify template_id or path, call indesign_list_templates()
Error 'Placeholder mismatch' → Check data_source.mapping matches template placeholders
Error 'Data source invalid' → Verify file path and format (CSV, JSON)
Error 'Template locked' → Template file is open, close it first
Error 'Document name conflict' → File already exists, choose different name
related_tools: indesign_get_template_details - See template structure and placeholders
indesign_create_product_catalog - Smart tool that includes this step
indesign_batch_create_from_template - Create multiple docs at once

typical_use_cases: Creating product catalogs from template with product data
Generating personalized business cards from template
Building branded brochures using company template

tools.name: indesign_add_pages
tools.description:
Add pages to existing InDesign document.

Inserts pages:
- At specific position (beginning, end, or after specific page)
- With specified master page applied
- Single pages or page spreads
- Optionally copies content from existing page

Use this when:
- User needs to expand document
- User wants to add sections
- User is building document dynamically
- User needs more pages for content

Common scenarios:
1. 'Add 5 pages to catalog' → Expand document
2. 'Insert page after page 3' → Specific position
3. 'Add blank page at end' → Append page
4. 'Duplicate page 5' → Copy existing page

after_page.description: Page number to insert after (required if position='after')

master_page.description: Master page name to apply (e.g., 'Content', 'Cover'). If omitted, uses default.

copy_from_page.description: Page number to copy content from (optional)

examples.description: Add 3 pages to end of document

when_to_use: Document needs more pages for content
User is expanding catalog or brochure
User wants to add section to document
User needs to duplicate existing page
workflow: Step 2: Call indesign_add_pages() with position and count
Step 3: Note new_page_numbers for adding content
Step 4: Add content to new pages with other tools
best_practices: Add pages in batches rather than one at a time
Apply appropriate master pages for consistency
Consider page spreads for facing page documents
error_handling: Error 'Document not found' → Verify document_id is correct
Error 'Invalid after_page' → Page number doesn't exist
Error 'Master page not found' → Check master page names with indesign_list_master_pages()
Error 'Exceeds page limit' → Documents limited to 9999 pages
related_tools: indesign_apply_master_page - Change master page on existing pages

tools.name: indesign_delete_pages
tools.description:
Remove specified pages from InDesign document.

Deletes pages with options to:
- Delete single page or page range
- Preserve or delete content
- Adjust page numbering
- Handle master page overrides

Use when:
- Removing unnecessary pages
- Restructuring document
- Cleaning up document
- Adjusting page count

Content on deleted pages is permanently removed unless backed up.

page_numbers.description: Page numbers to delete (e.g., [3, 5, 7] or [10] for single page)

error_handling: Error 'Page not found' → Page number doesn't exist
Error 'Cannot delete last page' → Document must have at least 1 page
related_tools: indesign_add_pages - Add pages back if needed

tools.name: indesign_move_pages
tools.description:
Reorder pages within InDesign document.

Move pages:
- Single page or page ranges
- To specific position
- Before or after target page
- Preserving page content and formatting

Use for document reorganization and page sequencing.

workflow: Step 1: Identify source and target pages
error_handling: Error 'Invalid page number' → Check page exists
Error 'Cannot move to same position' → Source equals target

tools.name: indesign_duplicate_page
tools.description:
Create exact copy of page within document.

Duplicates page with:
- All content and formatting
- Master page assignments
- Overrides preserved
- Insert at specified position

Faster than recreating page layout manually.

examples.description: Duplicate page 5 and insert after page 10

workflow: Step 3: Modify duplicated content as needed
error_handling: Error 'Page not found' → Source page doesn't exist

tools.name: indesign_set_page_size
tools.description:
Change page dimensions of existing document.

Modifies:
- Page width and height
- Orientation
- All pages or specific pages
- Preserves content positioning option

Use when page size needs adjustment after creation.

error_handling: Error 'Content overflow' → Content doesn't fit new size
Error 'Invalid size' → Check dimensions

tools.name: indesign_set_document_margins
tools.description:
Modify margin settings for document pages.

Adjusts:
- Top, bottom, left, right margins
- Inside/outside for facing pages
- Apply to all pages or specific pages
- Column gutter settings

Margins guide content placement and maintain consistency.

examples.description: Set 1 inch margins on all pages

best_practices: Account for binding with larger inside margin
Check content doesn't overflow new margins
error_handling: Error 'Margins too large' → Margins exceed page size

tools.name: indesign_create_master_page
tools.description:
Create new master page for document.

Master pages define:
- Consistent page layouts
- Headers and footers
- Page numbers
- Repeating elements
- Grid and guide structures

Essential for multi-page document consistency.

workflow: Step 3: Apply to pages with indesign_apply_master_page()
best_practices: Base masters on existing for hierarchy
error_handling: Error 'Master name exists' → Choose unique name

tools.name: indesign_apply_master_page
tools.short_description: Apply master page template to document pages for consistent layout
tools.description:
Apply master page to document pages.

Applies master:
- To single page or page range
- Overrides previous master
- Preserves or removes overrides
- Updates page layout

Changes page structure based on master template.

best_practices: Use different masters for different sections
error_handling: Error 'Master not found' → Check master_page_id
Error 'Page not found' → Verify page numbers
related_tools: indesign_override_master_items - Modify master elements on page

tools.name: indesign_list_master_pages
tools.short_description: List all master pages in InDesign document with names and properties
tools.description:
List all master pages in document.

Returns master page details:
- Master page names
- Applied page count
- Parent master relationships
- Master page structure

Use to discover available masters before applying.

error_handling: Error 'Document not found' → Verify document_id

tools.name: indesign_create_section
tools.description:
Create document section with custom page numbering.

Sections enable:
- Custom page numbering styles
- Different numbering per section
- Roman numerals, letters, numbers
- Section markers and prefixes

Essential for books with front matter, body, and appendices.

examples.description: Create front matter section with roman numerals

workflow: Step 2: Call indesign_create_section() for each section
Step 3: Set page numbering with indesign_set_page_numbering()
best_practices: Use roman numerals for front matter
error_handling: Error 'Page already in section' → Delete existing section first
related_tools: indesign_create_master_page - Include page numbers in master

tools.name: indesign_merge_documents
tools.description:
Combine multiple InDesign documents into single document.

Merges documents:
- Preserves all content and formatting
- Combines master pages
- Merges styles and swatches
- Maintains page order
- Resolves naming conflicts

Essential for assembling multi-part projects.

source_documents.description: Array of document paths to merge

error_handling: Error 'Source not found' → Verify all paths
Error 'Style conflict' → Use resolve_conflicts parameter
